description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Repressing IL-18 has negative effects on atherosclerotic lesion composition and progression.
Claim 2: IL-6 signaling plays a major role in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: IL-6 signaling plays a major role in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
rationale: By contrast, for every copy of 358Ala inherited, mean concentration of IL6R increased by 34·3% (95% CI 30·4-38·2) and of interleukin 6 by 14·6% (10·7-18·4), and mean concentration of C-reactive protein was reduced by 7·5% (5·9-9·1) and of fibrinogen by 1·0% (0·7-1·3).
For every copy of 358Ala inherited, risk of coronary heart disease was reduced by 3·4% (1·8-5·0).
INTERPRETATION Large-scale human genetic and biomarker data are consistent with a causal association between IL6R-related pathways and coronary heart disease.

seeds.text: Repressing IL-18 has negative effects on atherosclerotic lesion composition and progression.
rationale: Interestingly, significantly higher levels of IL-18 mRNA were found in symptomatic (unstable) plaques than asymptomatic (stable) plaques (P<0.01).
CONCLUSIONS These results suggest, for the first time, a major role for IL-18 in atherosclerotic plaque destabilization leading to acute ischemic syndromes.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: IL-6 signaling plays a major role in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Repressing IL-18 has negative effects on atherosclerotic lesion composition and progression.

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that repressing IL-18 has negative effects on atherosclerotic lesion composition and progression.
